children: Magnolia Oil & Gas Corp. (MGY) filed a Form 8K - Unregistered Sales of Equity - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 14, 2026.

The information set forth in the "Introductory Note" and Item 1.01 of this Current Report regarding the Equity Consideration is hereby incorporated by reference into this Item 3.02. The issuance of shares of common stock was completed in reliance upon the exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act, provided by Section 4(a)(2) thereof as a transaction by an issuer not involving any public offering.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1698990/000110465926107498/tm2625234d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1698990/000110465926107498/0001104659-26-107498-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
